title: Pure Trade creates Lancôme's festive The Suite Escape Palette
summary: For the 2026 holiday season, Lancôme entrusted Pure Trade Worldwide with the design and manufacture of the case for The Suite Escape Palette, dressed in a décor created by French artist Octave Marsal. The challenge for P…
ai_summary: Pure Trade Worldwide was commissioned by Lancôme to design and produce the case for The Suite Escape Palette for the 2026 holiday season. The case features décor by French artist Octave Marsal.
